name: open311
label: Open311 (Civic Tech)
description: US government service request standard — 311 calls, civic issues, public services
short_description: US government service request standard — 311 calls, civic issues, public services
long_description: Open311 is the standard API protocol for civic service requests — potholes, broken streetlights, graffiti, noise complaints — enabling citizens to report issues and track resolution. The schema covers jurisdiction registration, service type catalog with custom attribute definitions, and individual service request records with geolocation, status, and agency assignment.
when_to_use: Use for 311 call center systems, civic engagement apps, smart city service management, or citizen reporting platforms. Adopted by cities including Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, and New York. Required for SeeClickFix, Salesforce Government Cloud, and Microsoft Azure for Government integrations. Growing adoption through EU Smart City Marketplace and FIWARE ecosystem.

table_notes.o311_jurisdiction: Registry of municipal or agency jurisdictions that expose Open311 endpoints; one row per city or government entity.
table_notes.o311_service: Catalog of reportable service types offered by a jurisdiction (e.g. pothole, graffiti, noise); each has a unique service_code within its jurisdiction.
table_notes.o311_service_request: Individual citizen-submitted issue reports with location, status lifecycle, and contact details; the primary transactional table.
table_notes.o311_attribute: Custom metadata fields (attributes) that extend a service’s data collection form; supports multiple datatypes and ordered display.

o311_jurisdiction.name: id
o311_jurisdiction.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the jurisdiction

o311_jurisdiction.name: name
o311_jurisdiction.description: Human-readable name of the municipality or agency (e.g. City of Chicago)

o311_jurisdiction.name: url
o311_jurisdiction.description: Base URL of the jurisdiction’s Open311 API endpoint

o311_jurisdiction.name: locale
o311_jurisdiction.description: BCP 47 locale tag for the jurisdiction’s default language (e.g. en-US, es-MX)

o311_jurisdiction.name: timezone
o311_jurisdiction.description: IANA timezone name for interpreting local timestamps (e.g. America/Chicago)

o311_jurisdiction.name: geo_boundary
o311_jurisdiction.description: PostGIS polygon defining the jurisdiction’s geographic boundary in WGS84

o311_service.name: id
o311_service.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the service type

o311_service.name: jurisdiction_id
o311_service.description: References o311_jurisdiction — the municipality that offers this service

o311_service.name: service_code
o311_service.description: Open311 service identifier, unique within a jurisdiction (e.g. 001, pothole)

o311_service.name: service_name
o311_service.description: Display name shown to citizens when selecting a service to report

o311_service.name: description
o311_service.description: Explanation of what this service covers and when citizens should use it

o311_service.name: metadata
o311_service.description: True if this service has custom attribute definitions in o311_attribute

o311_service.name: type
o311_service.description: Open311 service type: realtime, batch, or blackbox (determines processing mode)

o311_service.name: keywords
o311_service.description: JSON array of search keywords for this service (e.g. ["pothole", "road", "pavement"])

o311_service.name: category_group
o311_service.description: Category grouping for UI display (e.g. Streets, Parks, Sanitation)

o311_service_request.name: id
o311_service_request.description: UUID primary key; Open311 spec mandates a globally unique service request identifier

o311_service_request.name: service_id
o311_service_request.description: References o311_service — the type of issue being reported

o311_service_request.name: status
o311_service_request.description: Open311 lifecycle status: open (received/in-progress) or closed (resolved)

o311_service_request.name: status_notes
o311_service_request.description: Agency-provided notes explaining the current status or resolution outcome

o311_service_request.name: agency_responsible
o311_service_request.description: Name of the department or agency assigned to handle this request

o311_service_request.name: description
o311_service_request.description: Citizen-provided description of the issue being reported

o311_service_request.name: requested_datetime
o311_service_request.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted (timezone-aware)

o311_service_request.name: updated_datetime
o311_service_request.description: Timestamp of the last status update or agency action on this request

o311_service_request.name: expected_datetime
o311_service_request.description: Agency-estimated resolution date and time for this request

o311_service_request.name: address
o311_service_request.description: Human-readable address string for the reported issue location

o311_service_request.name: location
o311_service_request.description: PostGIS point geometry of the issue location in WGS84 (for spatial queries)

o311_service_request.name: media_url
o311_service_request.description: URL to a photo or video uploaded by the citizen as evidence of the issue

o311_service_request.name: requestor_email
o311_service_request.description: Citizen’s email address for status notifications (RFC 5321 max length)

o311_service_request.name: requestor_phone
o311_service_request.description: Citizen’s phone number for follow-up contact (E.164 or local format)

o311_service_request.name: token
o311_service_request.description: Temporary tracking token issued before a permanent UUID is assigned (async services)

o311_attribute.name: id
o311_attribute.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the attribute definition

o311_attribute.name: service_id
o311_attribute.description: References o311_service — the service this attribute extends

o311_attribute.name: variable
o311_attribute.description: True if this attribute accepts user input; false if it is informational only

o311_attribute.name: code
o311_attribute.description: Machine-readable identifier for the attribute used in API submissions

o311_attribute.name: datatype
o311_attribute.description: Input type: string, number, datetime, text, singlevaluelist, or multivaluelist

o311_attribute.name: required
o311_attribute.description: True if this attribute must be provided when submitting a service request

o311_attribute.name: description
o311_attribute.description: Human-readable label or question shown to the citizen for this attribute

o311_attribute.name: datatype_description
o311_attribute.description: Instructions or validation hints displayed alongside the input field

o311_attribute.name: order_num
o311_attribute.description: Display order of this attribute within the service’s submission form

o311_attribute.name: allowed_values
o311_attribute.description: JSON array of {key, name} objects for list-type attributes (e.g. [{"key":"1","name":"Yes"}])
